description: Uploads one native ChatGPT attachment to the connected Magic Hour account: PNG/JPEG/WebP images, MP4/MOV/WebM video, or MP3/WAV/M4A/FLAC/Ogg/WebM audio, up to 20 MiB. Set media_type to the attachment's actual kind, not the requested output: image, video or audio. For multiple references, call separately and keep each returned file_path paired with the intended input. Pass the real attachment through the file parameter; a bare file ID, filename or chat-local path is not the raw MCP file object. Does not generate media or spend generation credits.

file.description: Native ChatGPT attachment object containing download_url and file_id.

download_url.description: Exact HTTPS download URL supplied for the native ChatGPT attachment, including its signed query.

file_id.description: Native ChatGPT file identifier paired with download_url; not a local filesystem path.

file_name.description: Original attachment filename, when supplied by ChatGPT.

mime_type.description: Attachment MIME type, when supplied by ChatGPT.

media_type.description: Actual input attachment kind: image, video or audio, not the desired output kind.

name: upload_chatgpt_media
title: Upload attached media
